title: Human Rights Watch: at least six EU member states, including Bulgaria and Denmark, have sold surveillance tech to 24+ countries known for violating human rights (Ryan Gallagher/Bloomberg)
summary: Ryan Gallagher / Bloomberg: Human Rights Watch: at least six EU member states, including Bulgaria and Denmark, have sold surveillance tech to 24+ countries known for violating human rights — European companies have sold controversial surveillance technologies to countries known for violating human rights, a new report has found.
